purpose: Say a result holds even if a condition occurs.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
て-form + も; adjective ～くても; noun / な-adjective + でも.
We will play even if it rains.
Even if it is expensive, I will buy it if necessary.
This shop is open even on Sundays.
An unexpected fact or a condition that changes nothing
formation: て-form + も; adjective ～くても; noun / な-adjective + でも.
restrictions: Unlike ordinary conditional forms, it maintains the result despite the condition.
mistake: Use the correct connector for the word class.
